BINANCE.historicalRole: observer keypair distinct from executor keypair

rules: read-only authoritative account reality must graduate before demo/testnet order submission
no credential may be discovered from ambient environment, config files, shell history or local secret stores while credentialUseAdmission is NOT_ADMITTED
credential admission requires a separate explicit user authorization
read-only admission must not imply TRADE, withdrawal, demo-order or live-order authority
venue-native account/order/trade reality remains authoritative; Market Capital may only normalize and reconcile it
observer credential locations are explicitly bound; secret bytes remain external to the repository and executor credentials are excluded
fresh private-account permission verification must succeed before privateAccountDataAllowed may become true
normalization is pure and must not read credentials, open network connections, or create execution authority
